email.subject: Temperature alarm - RB-24093 / AWB 717-4821 3377
email.body:
Dear Lena,

during our periodic review we downloaded the ColdTrace logger of shipment RB-24093, received on 30 Oct 2026. Our apologies: the logger was not read at goods receipt because of a staffing gap at our dock.

The logger shows an alarm on 28 Oct 2026: maximum 13.0 °C, approx. 90 minutes above 8 °C. The goods are quarantined in our cold room pending your QA disposition. Logger file attached.

Kind regards,
Dana Whitfield
QA Manager, Harborview Specialty Distribution

email.subject: Custody records requested - RB-24093
email.body:
Dear Markus,

the logger of RB-24093 shows an excursion to 13.0 °C on 28 Oct 2026. Please send us the custody and handling records for this shipment under clause 5.3 of our agreement as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Lena Hartmann
Head of Distribution Logistics, Rheinfeld Biologics

email.subject: RE: Custody records requested - RB-24093
email.body:
Dear Lena,

our records show the shipment was tendered to Boreal Air Cargo at FRA at 2026-10-28 17:00 UTC and collected from Boreal at BOS at 2026-10-29 17:00 UTC. Our hub and truck records for both legs are within 2-8 °C.

Boreal's ramp handler issued the attached irregularity report: the pieces were staged on apron V114 during an aircraft delay. Please note clause 4.3 of our agreement for the air leg. We are happy to support your notice to the carrier.

Kind regards,
Markus Feld
Claims Desk, NordStar Logistics

temperature_duty.title: Temperature Range
temperature_duty.quote: Temperature Range. The Forwarder shall keep the Goods within the Temperature Range at all times while they are in its Custody, using qualified and validated equipment.

hub_storage.title: Hub storage
hub_storage.quote: Hub storage. At all Forwarder hubs and warehouses the Goods shall be stored exclusively in qualified cold rooms maintained at +2 °C to +8 °C. The Goods shall not be staged in ambient areas, on docks or on warehouse floors for longer than 30 minutes in aggregate per hub.

air_carriers.title: Air carriers
air_carriers.quote: Air carriers. In respect of carriage by air performed by an air carrier, the Forwarder's liability shall not exceed the amount the Forwarder is able to recover from that air carrier under the Montreal Convention 1999 or other applicable air law. On request, the Forwarder shall assign to the Customer its rights of action against the air carrier.

excursion_reporting.title: Excursion reporting
excursion_reporting.quote: Excursion reporting. The Forwarder shall notify the Customer in writing of any known or suspected Temperature Excursion within 24 hours of becoming aware of it.

liability_basis.title: Basis
liability_basis.quote: Basis. The Forwarder is liable for loss of or damage to the Goods, including damage resulting from a Temperature Excursion, occurring while the Goods are in its Custody, unless it proves that the loss arose from circumstances it could not avoid and whose consequences it could not prevent.

liability_cap.title: Limit of liability
liability_cap.quote: Limit of liability. The Forwarder's liability shall be limited to 8.33 Special Drawing Rights (SDR) per kilogram of gross weight of the Goods lost or damaged.

damaged_goods.title: Damaged goods
damaged_goods.quote: Damaged goods. Goods that the Customer's Quality Assurance rejects as a result of a Temperature Excursion are deemed damaged. The Customer's documented QA decision is conclusive in the absence of manifest error.

temperature_cover.title: Cover
temperature_cover.quote: Cover. This policy is extended to cover physical loss of or damage to the subject-matter insured caused by a deviation from the temperature range stated in the shipping documents, as recorded by the accompanying data logger.

damage_definition.title: Damage
damage_definition.quote: Damage. Goods shall be deemed damaged where the Insured's Quality Assurance, acting reasonably and in accordance with documented stability data, rejects them as a consequence of the deviation. Goods released by Quality Assurance are not damaged within the meaning of this policy.

minimum_duration.title: Minimum duration
minimum_duration.quote: Minimum duration. Deviations lasting less than 60 consecutive minutes are not covered under this extension.

packing_exclusion.quote: Loss, damage or expense caused by insufficiency or unsuitability of packing or preparation of the subject-matter insured, where such packing is carried out by the Insured or its employees.

settlement.title: Measure of indemnity
settlement.quote: Measure of indemnity. In the event of total loss of the affected goods the Insurer will pay the insured value (100% of invoice value) less the deductible stated in the Schedule.

notification.title: Notification
notification.quote: Notification. The Insured shall notify the Insurer in writing of any loss or damage that may give rise to a claim as soon as practicable and in any event within 30 days of discovery.

preservation.quote: Duty of the Insured - preservation of rights. It is the duty of the Insured to ensure that all rights against carriers, bailees or other third parties are properly preserved and exercised, including by giving written notice of damage within the time limits applicable under the relevant contract or convention. The Insurer may reduce any claim to the extent of prejudice caused by a failure to do so.
